# apple_device (Data Source)

Looks up a registered device by its App Store Connect ID or UDID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_device" "test_phone" {
  udid = "00008030-001A2B3C4D5E6F70"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the device. Set this or `udid`.
- `udid` (String) UDID of the device. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `added_date` (String) When the device was registered, in RFC 3339 format.
- `device_class` (String) Class of the device, e.g. `IPHONE`.
- `model` (String) Model of the device.
- `name` (String) Name of the device.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the device.
- `status` (String) Status: `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`.
